epics.title: Foundation - Composable Patterns
epics.description: Establish core composable pattern infrastructure without actor contexts

epics.title: XState v5 Migration
epics.description: Upgrade all state machines from XState v4 to v5

epics.title: Composable Refactor - Basket Reference
epics.description: Refactor basket as reference implementation for new patterns

epics.title: Composable Refactor - Remaining Modules
epics.description: Apply new patterns to remaining modules

epics.title: Code Quality Improvements
epics.description: Documentation and code quality improvements from analysis

stories.title: Create createFeatureComposable() factory pattern
stories.description:
**As a** developer working on the Upmind platform,
**I want** a standard factory function for creating composable instances,
**So that** all composables follow a consistent initialization pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns machine, state, send, and service references

stories.title: Implement useFeatureMeta() pattern for flat flags
stories.description:
**As a** developer using composables,
**I want** a separate `useFeatureMeta()` composable that returns flat reactive flags,
**So that** I can access loading/error states without nested `.value` chains.
acceptanceCriteria: Meta composable returns flat refs (isLoading, isProcessing, hasError, etc.)
Shares same machine instance as main composable

stories.title: Implement useFeatureActions() pattern for methods only
stories.description:
**As a** developer who only needs to trigger actions,
**I want** a `useFeatureActions()` composable that returns only methods,
**So that** I can import just what I need for cleaner code.
acceptanceCriteria: Actions composable returns only action methods

stories.title: Implement useFeatureAdvanced() escape hatch pattern
stories.description:
**As a** power user or developer debugging,
**I want** a `useFeatureAdvanced()` composable that exposes the raw machine,
**So that** I have full access when needed without cluttering the simple API.
acceptanceCriteria: Advanced composable returns state, send, service

stories.title: Write unit tests for composable factory patterns
stories.description:
**As a** developer,
**I want** comprehensive tests for the new composable patterns,
**So that** I can refactor with confidence.

stories.title: Research XState v4 to v5 migration guide
stories.description:
**As a** developer planning the migration,
**I want** a documented summary of XState v4→v5 breaking changes,
**So that** we can plan the migration accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify patterns in our codebase that need updating

stories.title: Migrate basket.machine.ts to XState v5
stories.description:
**As a** developer,
**I want** the basket machine migrated to XState v5,
**So that** we have a reference implementation for other migrations.
acceptanceCriteria: Machine uses XState v5 createMachine API

stories.title: Migrate session.machine.ts to XState v5
stories.description:
**As a** developer,
**I want** the session machine migrated to XState v5,
**So that** authentication flows work with new patterns.

stories.title: Migrate remaining machines to XState v5
stories.description:
**As a** developer,
**I want** all remaining state machines migrated to XState v5,
**So that** the entire codebase uses consistent XState version.
acceptanceCriteria: All machines in headless package use v5
All machines in client-vue package use v5

stories.title: Update stateMatches utility for XState v5
stories.description:
**As a** developer using state matching,
**I want** the stateMatches utility updated for XState v5,
**So that** state matching works with new API.
acceptanceCriteria: stateMatches works with v5 state objects
API remains backwards compatible where possible

stories.title: Update useContext utility for XState v5
stories.description:
**As a** developer accessing context,
**I want** the useContext utility updated for XState v5,
**So that** context access works with new patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: useContext works with v5 snapshot API

stories.title: Update XState inspector integration for v5
stories.description:
**As a** developer debugging state machines,
**I want** the XState inspector to work with v5,
**So that** I can visualize machine state during development.

stories.title: Refactor useBasket() following new patterns
stories.description:
**As a** developer,
**I want** useBasket refactored to use the new composable patterns,
**So that** it serves as a reference implementation.

stories.title: Create useBasketMeta() with flat flags
stories.description:
**As a** developer using basket in UI,
**I want** a useBasketMeta() that returns flat reactive flags,
**So that** I can bind loading/error states easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns isLoading, isProcessing, hasError, canCheckout, isEmpty, hasProducts
All flags are flat Refs, not nested

stories.title: Create useBasketActions() with methods only
stories.description:
**As a** developer triggering basket actions,
**I want** a useBasketActions() that returns only action methods,
**So that** I import minimal code for action-only components.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns add, remove, clear, applyPromotion, setCurrency, checkout, refresh

stories.title: Create useBasketAdvanced() escape hatch
stories.description:
**As a** developer needing low-level access,
**I want** a useBasketAdvanced() that exposes raw machine access,
**So that** I can debug or do advanced operations.

stories.title: Update basket barrel exports
stories.description:
**As a** developer importing basket composables,
**I want** clean barrel exports for all basket composables,
**So that** imports are simple and discoverable.
acceptanceCriteria: index.ts exports useBasket, useBasketMeta, useBasketActions, useBasketAdvanced
No breaking changes to existing imports

stories.title: Document basket composable patterns
stories.description:
**As a** developer learning the new patterns,
**I want** documentation explaining the basket composable pattern,
**So that** I can apply it to other modules.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows usage examples for each composable
Documents when to use each variant

stories.title: Refactor remaining modules to new pattern
stories.description:

**So that** entire codebase uses consistent composable patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: domain, product, feedback, system modules refactored

stories.title: Update client-vue wrapper layer for new patterns
stories.description:
**As a** developer using client-vue,

acceptanceCriteria: No breaking changes to app imports
